title: 2 Peter 2:4-5: Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness (KJV and Greek)
summary: 2 Peter 2:5 header (English and Greek) with KJV verses 4 and 5 and the Greek of verse 5: God spared not the angels that sinned, nor the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness. "The eighth person" is underlined in orange and matches the large orange Greek word ὄγδοον; the N of Νῶε is green like the No of Noah.

text.text: 4 For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
5 And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
5 καὶ ἀρχαίου κόσμου οὐκ ἐφείσατο, ἀλλὰ ὄγδοον Νῶε δικαιοσύνης κήρυκα ἐφύλαξεν, κατακλυσμὸν κόσμῳ ἀσεβῶν ἐπάξας,

numbers.note: Noah the eighth person (ὄγδοον) saved in the flood
